summary:
What is happening to India's land, temperature and vegetation? Team Earth Boundless sets out to explore these questions through INDIA EARTH WATCH, developed for NASA's Be an Earth System Trend Detective challenge.

               Our project investigates environmental changes across India from 2015 to 2025 using NASA's MODIS satellite observations, focusing on Land Surface Temperature (LST) and vegetation greenness (NDVI).

             We use Google Earth Engine for satellite-data exploration and analysis, and Netlify to host our interactive website prototype. Through visualisations and an accessible interface, we aim to make complex Earth observation data easier to explore and understand.

           INDIA EARTH WATCH transforms satellite observations into an opportunity for environmental discovery, awareness and learning.
details:
INDIA EARTH WATCH is an environmental monitoring project by Team Earth Boundless. It explores changes in land-surface temperature and vegetation greenness across 34 Indian administrative regions from 2015 to 2025.

Our project uses NASA MODIS satellite datasets, including MOD11A2 and MOD13Q1, processed using Google Earth Engine.

We analyse annual regional data, compare environmental patterns and present findings through visualisations and an interactive website prototype.

Our goal is to make NASA Earth-observation data easier to understand and help people explore environmental changes across India.

The project combines satellite data analysis, data visualisation and web technologies to create an accessible environmental exploration platform.
